The year book splits these pages into three chapters with two different exam statuses: 'Chemical transmission at autonomic junctions' (physical 66-69, excluded), 'Receptors of the effector organs' (physical 69-73, NOT excluded) and 'Drugs that affect the autonomic activity' (physical 73-74, excluded). There is also a wording conflict on the third: the orientation says 'DRUGS THAT AFFECT THE AUTONOMIC ACTIVITY', which is the year book's exact heading; the module book prints 'AGENTS THAT AFFECT THE AUTONOMIC ACTIVITY'. Not resolved: splitting the module chapter to match the year book would invent boundaries the module book does not print, and merging silently would hide the fact that part of the chapter is off the paper.
